从相加和数乘两块元件起步，把箭头拼成新的箭头。: Starting from Add and Scale, put arrows together into new ones.
两个向量逐个分量相加；画出来，后一支箭头接在前一支的箭头尖上。: Two vectors added entry by entry; drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first.
把两个形状相同的向量逐个分量相加：几何上，第二支箭头接在第一支的箭头尖上，和从起: Adds two vectors of one shape entry by entry: drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the sum runs from the start to the end.
数 k 乘向量 v 的每个分量：箭头沿原来的直线伸长或缩短 k 倍，k 为负时掉: Multiplies every entry of the vector v by the number k: the arrow stretches or shrinks k times along its own line, and turns round when k is negative.
给出设定的那个数。: Gives the number it is set to.
向量是一支有方向的箭头，也是一列数。两支箭头<wiki-ref to=\"sum: A vector is an arrow with a direction, and a column of numbers. Two arrows make a <wiki-ref to="sum"></wiki-ref> when the second starts at the tip of the first.
